_doc: MAX2 U1(1) material zoning per fighter (art/tools/zone_grade.py; pipeline.build re-applies it after every build). Each zone: parts of the bake's part map, or boxes (rest position, Blender axes, m) x an ORM roughness band [lo, hi] x an optional min/max L*; hex = the hue (CIELAB angle of the colour), L = the zone's mean L*, C = its chroma, k = the texel's own L* deviation kept (default 1). Signature hues are content/fighters/<id>.json vfx.signature. Gate: lineup_qa sigPct >= 6 % and the bottom value band at L* 20-35. Round 2 (max2 r2): crown breaks (hoods, hats, halo, pauldrons) carry the signature hue at the covering's own value, so the top-down read leads with the signature and the bible's top band keeps its value (ruling 7: a pale covering over a pale robe gets a break); every zoned albedo ends with each reserved band at <= 8 % (ruling 32, zone_grade.py --reserve-cap). reserveModes: per band, how --reserve-cap moves texels (edge/lo/hi/sat; Burdam's harm browns turn redder, never gold). Round 2 fix (max2 r2f, U7): crown zones on the rest of the roster, chosen as a roster of hue families at the game camera so no two crowns of the same shape share one (zones may now intersect parts with rest-position boxes and --cyl rings: cx, cy, r0, r1, z0, z1); Tunlan's hat back to the concept's pale lacquered straw with the plum on its octagonal crown, an outer brim band and the iron rim (the r2 all-plum hat rendered as Dunsom's lilac disc at the game camera, hat dE76 13.3).
